summary: English and French first-party discovery identified the Ministry of Land Affairs, the Seke-Banza Kongo-Central registration district, and the BIC cadastral portal. queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed queries, URLs, direct requests, HTTP outcomes, bundle inspection, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-940-kinzao.json.
